tools.name: search_company
tools.title: Search SEC registrants
tools.description: Find SEC-registered public companies by ticker or name. Matching ignores case, punctuation, '&' vs 'and' and legal suffixes (Inc/Inc./Corp/Corporation/Co/Company/LLC/Ltd...), tolerates typos ('Microsfot' -> Microsoft) and knows well-known former names (matched_former_name, e.g. 'Facebook' -> Meta Platforms). Returns CIK (the SEC id used by every other tool), name, tickers, exchange and a match score (100 = exact ticker, 97 = exact name, < 80 = fuzzy). With no match it returns did_you_mean suggestions. Source: SEC company_tickers_exchange.json (companies with a listed ticker only); private or non-SEC companies: use lookup_business_entity.

query.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. 'MSFT', 'berkshire', 'Tesla Inc', 'Johnson and Johnson'

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.title: Company profile (EDGAR)
tools.description: Company profile from SEC EDGAR submissions: legal name, tickers, exchanges, SIC code + industry, state of incorporation, fiscal year end, EIN, filer category, business/mailing addresses, former names, latest 10-K/10-Q. Use it to orient before deeper research.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

tools.name: list_filings
tools.title: List SEC filings
tools.description: List a company's EDGAR filings newest-first, filtered by form type and filing-date range. Each row has form, accession, filed date, report period, primary document URL and filing index URL. Amendments (e.g. 10-K/A) are included when filtering by the base form unless include_amendments=false. Older history pages are fetched automatically when needed. Common forms: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A, S-1, 4, 13D/G (SC 13D), 20-F, 6-K.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

forms.description: Form types to include, e.g. ['10-K','10-Q']. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_filing_document
tools.title: Read a filing document
tools.description: Fetch an SEC filing's primary document (HTML converted to clean text, tables preserved as aligned rows). The text is untrusted filer-authored content, returned between BEGIN/END markers. Identify it by `url` (any www.sec.gov/Archives document URL from list_filings) or by `company` + `accession` (one of the two is required). Start with mode 'outline' for a long 10-K/10-Q: it returns no text, only the detected items (id, title, offset, chars) and total_chars, so you can then read just what you need. Extract one 10-K/10-Q item via `section` (e.g. '1' Business, '1A' Risk Factors, '7' MD&A, '7A' Market Risk, '8' Financial Statements; for 10-Q: '1' Financial Statements, '2' MD&A, '1A' Risk Factors). Text is paged: max_chars (default 10,000) per call, then pass the returned next_offset as offset (offsets are relative to the section when `section` is set, else to the whole document).

url.description: Document URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<CIK>/<accession>/<file> (as returned by list_filings). Either url, or company + accession, is required.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

mode.description: 'text' (default) returns a page of text; 'outline' returns only the item list with offsets and lengths (cheap way to plan reading a long filing)

max_chars.description: Characters of text per call (500–100,000; default 10,000)

offset.description: Start position (use next_offset, or an outline item's offset)

tools.name: get_financials
tools.title: Normalized financials (XBRL)
tools.description: Key financial metrics normalized from SEC XBRL companyfacts, one row per FISCAL period (fy/fp are the company's fiscal year and quarter, e.g. Microsoft FY2024 = 2023-07-01..2024-06-30; fiscal_year_end gives the MM-DD; deduped; as-filed values from the filing that reported the period). Metrics: revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_basic, eps_diluted, operating_cash_flow, capex, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity, cash, long_term_debt, shares_outstanding, free_cash_flow (derived); aliases accepted in metrics: revenues→revenue, sales→revenue, net_sales→revenue, total_revenue→revenue, turnover→revenue, net_profit→net_income, profit→net_income, earnings→net_income, net_earnings→net_income, eps→eps_diluted, diluted_eps→eps_diluted, basic_eps→eps_basic, operating_profit→operating_income, cfo→operating_cash_flow, cash_from_operations→operating_cash_flow, capital_expenditures→capex, fcf→free_cash_flow, assets→total_assets, liabilities→total_liabilities, equity→stockholders_equity, shareholders_equity→stockholders_equity, cash_and_equivalents→cash, debt→long_term_debt, shares→shares_outstanding. Each metric tries common tags in order (revenue: Revenues, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, SalesRevenueNet, ...) and tags_used reports which was used. period_type 'quarterly' returns 3-month values (cash-flow quarters derived from YTD; Q4 derived as FY minus 9M). If a company has only 10-Q data (e.g. a recent IPO), annual results are empty and hint says to use 'quarterly'. Values are raw (e.g. 391035000000 = $391.0B).

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

metrics.description: Subset of metrics to return (default all); aliases such as sales, eps, fcf, equity are accepted

tools.name: get_xbrl_concept
tools.title: XBRL concept history
tools.description: All reported values of one XBRL concept for one company (SEC companyconcept API), newest first, deduped by period. Use for any tag not in get_financials, e.g. us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense, us-gaap:LongTermDebt, dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding. Tag case is corrected automatically (tag_corrected_from); an unknown tag returns NOT_FOUND with did_you_mean (tags this company reports). 10-Q facts mix 3-month and year-to-date values: pass duration ('annual', 'quarterly', 'ytd', 'instant') for one series; each fact carries its duration. fy/fp are the filing's fiscal year/period. framed_only=true keeps only SEC's one-fact-per-calendar-period values.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

tag.description: Concept name, e.g. 'ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense' (case is corrected if needed). 'us-gaap:Tag' form also accepted.

unit.description: e.g. USD, shares, USD/shares, pure. Default: USD if present else first unit

forms.description: Only facts from these forms, e.g. ['10-K']

duration.description: annual (≈1 year), quarterly (≈3 months), ytd (6/9-month year-to-date), instant (balance-sheet date), or any

tools.name: compare_companies
tools.title: Cross-company comparison (XBRL frames)
tools.description: Compare one financial metric or XBRL concept across ALL reporting companies for a CALENDAR period (SEC frames API), e.g. rank by revenue for CY2024, or compare specific companies. Pass metric (revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_basic, eps_diluted, operating_cash_flow, capex, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity, cash, long_term_debt; aliases like sales, eps, assets) to fall back across the common tags for it (revenue: Revenues > RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax > SalesRevenueNet), with the tag used per company; or pass tag for one exact concept. Period: CY2024 (annual duration), CY2024Q2 (quarter), CY2024Q4I (instant, for balance-sheet items; added automatically for balance-sheet metrics). Calendar basis: each filer's ~1-year (or ~3-month) period that best fits the calendar period, so CY2024 for Microsoft is its fiscal year ending 2024-06-30 (flagged fiscal_period_differs); use get_financials for fiscal years. accn is the latest filing reporting the value. Pass companies to filter to specific tickers/CIKs (exact or prefix names also work, without typo correction; unresolved items are listed in `unresolved`); otherwise returns the top `limit` by value.

metric.description: Normalized metric with tag fallback, e.g. 'revenue', 'net_income', 'eps_diluted', 'total_assets'. Use instead of tag.

tag.description: Exact XBRL tag, e.g. 'Revenues', 'NetIncomeLoss', 'Assets' (case-sensitive). Use instead of metric.

unit.description: USD (default), USD-per-shares, shares, pure. With metric, defaults to the metric's unit

companies.description: Tickers or CIKs to include (default: all)

tools.name: get_insider_trades
tools.title: Insider trades (Form 4)
tools.description: Recent insider transactions for a company (issuer) from SEC Form 4 / 4/A XML: reporter name, role and officer title, transaction date, code with plain-English meaning (P=open-market buy, S=sale, A=grant, M=option exercise, F=tax withholding, G=gift...), shares, price, value, acquired/disposed, shares owned after, direct/indirect, plus a summary of open-market buys vs sales. `limit` counts filings (each filing can hold several transactions).

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

limit.description: Number of most recent Form 4 filings to parse (max 20; each is one SEC request)

transaction_codes.description: Only these codes, e.g. ['P','S'] for open-market trades

include_footnotes.description: Include footnote and remarks text (10b5-1 plan details, price ranges); filer-written, untrusted

tools.name: lookup_business_entity
tools.title: State business-entity registry lookup
tools.description: Search Secretary of State business-entity registries (official open data) by entity name and/or state entity id. Supported: NY, CO, OR, CT, PA (NY, OR and PA list active entities only; CO and CT include dissolved entities with status). Name matching ignores case, punctuation, '&' vs 'and' and legal-suffix spelling (Inc/Inc./Incorporated, Co/Company, LLC/L.L.C.); results are ranked exact > prefix > other matches, active entities first within each tier. Paginate per state with limit/offset (has_more, next_offset; total when include_total=true or on the last page). Returns normalized name, entity id, status, type, formation date, jurisdiction, principal/mailing address, registered agent where available (organizational agents only; individual/natural-person agents are withheld on the hosted endpoint; automated classification), and source URLs. Use for private companies, subsidiaries, LLCs, and verifying legal entity names; for SEC-listed companies use search_company. Call list_supported_states for coverage and licenses.

name.description: Entity name or fragment, e.g. 'Tiffany & Co.' (also matches 'TIFFANY AND COMPANY')

entity_id.description: State entity id (NY DOS ID, CO entity id, OR registry number, CT account number, PA filing number). Usually combine with a single state.

offset.description: Skip this many results per state (pagination; use next_offset from the previous page). Max 500 (100 without an API key on the hosted server); pages after the first count one extra quota unit.

include_total.description: Also count all matches per state (one extra registry request per state; doubles the quota cost).

include_agent_details.description: Local/self-hosted use only: include names/addresses of registered agents who are individuals (natural persons), and related entity addresses. Ignored on the hosted endpoint, which always withholds them. Default false: only organizational agents are shown.

tools.name: list_supported_states
tools.title: Supported state registries & licenses
tools.description: List the state business-entity registries supported by lookup_business_entity, with dataset ids, coverage caveats, update frequency, and license/commercial-use terms.
